name: alpha-review
description: Open the alpha review screen to mark judge keepers as gold or miss, read per-miner precision, and print the eval state. Use when tuning a miner's accuracy. Thin launcher over the existing harvest engine and local review server. Triggers: "/alpha-review", "alpha screen", "open the review screen".
